messages:
Jen Support: FYI — AcmeCo invoice autopay failed repeatedly this morning. Customer says card declined then 3DS challenge timed out, ended up with 4 attempts. Example attempt id: pay_at_20240305_9876. API response below.

Eli (eng-runtime): can you paste the raw response + request ids? Also which environment (prod/us-east)?

Jen Support: prod/us-east. Response:
```json
{
  "payment_attempt_id": "pay_at_20240305_9876",
  "status": "declined",
  "decline_reason": "insufficient_funds",
  "decline_source": "issuer",
  "3ds": {
    "required": true,
    "acs_url": "https://acs.bank/txn/abcd",
    "challenge_status": "timeout"
  },
  "gateway_txn_id": "g_559900",
  "fraud_score": 28
}
```
Also client-side logs: iframe timed out after 10s, user closed window.

Priya (fraud): fraud_score 28 is low, so unlikely fraud block. Check BIN-level blocks and issuer responses for FRI (fraud review) codes. Which gateway returned the decline?

Jen Support: gateway_x.

Eli (eng-runtime): I pulled gateway logs: issuer returned R01/Insufficient_Funds then ACS challenge started and ACS responded with 'no-response' at 10s. See gateway trace id gtrace-214912.

Sam (finance): Customer is on PO invoicing but autopay attempted card on file; merchant wants retries but not to spam issuer. We should avoid immediate retries — recommend exponential backoff 1m, 5m, 30m and stop after 3 attempts, then create invoice fallback.

Jen Support: Repro steps from merchant:
1) Create invoice with autopay=true
2) POST /v1/payments/charge with card_token and invoice_id
3) If response.status == 'declined' and 3ds.required -> open ACS iframe with acs_url
4) Merchant reported iframe timing out (CSP / sameSite?), but client console shows 10s timeout.

Eli (eng-runtime): Action items:
- Check our iframe timeout default (currently 10s), increase to 30s for ACS frames. (ENG-4261)
- Add better telemetry: log ACS challenge duration and outcome. (ENG-4262)
- Implement retry policy change to exponential backoff on autopay. (PLAT-300)

Priya (fraud): Also add tag when decline_reason == 'insufficient_funds' so support shows next-best actions: email buyer, wait, or request alternative payment. -> (SUP-920)

ops-bot: Deploy started: payment-retry-policy v2 to canary
ops-bot: Deploy successful to canary (10% traffic)

Eli (eng-runtime): Rolled change to increase iframe timeout in canary. Will monitor ACS success rate.

Jen Support: I'll notify merchant and recommend they pause autopay retrials until we finish. Assigning to @Eli for follow-up and @Priya for fraud checks. Thanks :thumbsup:

Priya (fraud): I'll scan for similar incidents across merchants (last 24h).

Sam (finance): Also check if VAT/tax logic affects retry triggers — unlikely here but good to confirm.

Jen Support: Closing loop for now. Will reopen if we see repeated failures after infra changes.
